notes.title: V0.2: The Demo Has Been Updated!
notes.notes:
[p]Dear players, long time no see![/p][p]Since the Steam Next Fest, Bread-kun has been hard at work making the game every single day ヾ(◍°∇°◍)ﾉﾞ
[/p][p]We're almost there! Hoping to officially meet you all in [b]September[/b]!
In the meantime, we’ve pushed a new demo update![/p][p][/p][p]Compared to the previous version, the game has changed [b]a lot[/b].
Bread-kun is very sorry to inform you that your [b]old demo save data will be reset[/b] (sobs).[/p][p][/p][p]But don’t worry—we’ve added a brand new onboarding flow, helpful guidance, and a bunch of rewards!
You’ll also be able to unlock meta-progression faster now!
We hope you’ll give the new content a try and share your thoughts with us :D[/p][p][/p][h3]✨ Major Updates:[/h3][p][/p][h3][b]New Player Guidance[/b][/h3][p]Thanks to your feedback, we’ve revamped the early tutorial to help players ease into the game.[/p][p]Now, from the very beginning, you can choose between:[/p][list][*][p][b]Questionnaire Mode[/b] — for MBTI enthusiasts[/p][/*][*][p][b]Roguelike Mode[/b] — our core gameplay loop[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Questionnaire Mode[/b] now allows you to end early after 5 minutes and get your results.
[b]Roguelike Mode[/b] includes tutorial prompts in the first run to help new players understand how the 4 MBTI letters relate to the 4 elementals and how they combine into different personality types.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Reward System[/b][/h3][p]When you win a game, you can now unlock new rewards based on certain conditions.
For example, winning your first game as ENFJ will unlock a powerful ENFJ-related trait!
Only part of the reward pool is available in this demo—the full set will come in the final release.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Persona Masks[/b][/h3][p]With this update, personality masks are now tied to the reward system as well.
This demo features [b]7 starter masks[/b], each hiding a little easter egg.
Let’s see if you MBTI fans and roguelike pros can uncover them![/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Animations[/b][/h3][p]All upgraded elemental forms now have full animation frames!
We’ve also updated many of the skill effects—hope you enjoy the visual glow-up![/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Control Modes[/b][/h3][p]Some players found the previous control scheme a bit clunky, so we’ve added a new one! (Bread-kun is really trying to satisfy everyone’s preferences...)[/p][p]Now you can choose between two firing modes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Toggle Fire Mode[/b]: Elementals fire automatically. Press the fire button to switch between shooting and stopping.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hold-to-Fire Mode[/b]: Hold down the fire button to attack, release to stop.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h3][p]There were just [i]too many[/i] changes to list everything… but here’s a sneak peek:[/p][list][*][p][b]INTP got buffed![/b] (By popular demand!) Several upgrades have been improved or reworked[/p][/*][*][p][b]INTJ and INFJ got minor nerfs[/b] (But don’t worry—these Ni powerhouses are still strong!)[/p][/*][*][p]Skill upgrades across all personality types have been tweaked[/p][/*][*][p]Elemental evolution branches have also been rebalanced[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Localization[/b][/h3][p]Our game now supports:[/p][list][*][p]Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Traditional Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]English[/p][/*][*][p]German[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Korean[/p][/*][/list][p]Since our team is not made up of native speakers for all these languages, we know the translations won’t be perfect. We appreciate your understanding and would [b]love[/b] for you to join our community and help us polish them![/p][p][/p][p](Yes, codex is coming... It’s in the works...)[/p]

notes.title: V0.1.1 Patch Notes · Save File Recovery Guide
notes.notes:
[p]Dear Players,[/p][p]First and foremost, I want to extend my sincerest apologies. Due to my personal error during this update, some of you have experienced lost save files, causing significant inconvenience and frustration. I feel deeply ashamed and have reflected on my carelessness. Please accept my heartfelt apology, and thank you for your understanding and patience.[/p][p][/p][h2]V0.1.1 Patch Notes · Save File Recovery Guide[/h2][p][b]What’s New[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]Reduced Test Mode Duration[/b][/p][list][*][p]Based on extensive feedback that the test mode was too long, we’ve cut the duration in half. After five minutes, you can choose to settle and enter Roguelike mode, or continue the full test.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Updated Taskbar Icon[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated Game Folder Path (The cause of everything)[/b][/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h2]Save File Recovery Instructions[/h2][p]Because of my mistake when updating the game folder path, some old save files didn’t migrate correctly and were lost. I’m truly sorry for the trouble! If you find your progress missing, please follow these steps to recover your save:[/p][olist][*][p]Open File Explorer and navigate to:[/p][code]C:\\Users\\YOURNAME\\AppData\\LocalLow\\MBTactics\\InsideCreaturesOut\\save.json[/code][p]Locate and copy the save.json file.[/p][/*][*][p]Paste the copied save.json into:[/p][code]C:\\Users\\YOURNAME\\AppData\\LocalLow\\MBTactics\\16CP-Survivors\\save.json[/code][p]Restart the game and check if your save has been restored.[/p][/*][/olist][p]If this method doesn’t recover your save, please contact us:[/p][list][*][p][b]Official Discord[/b]: [url="https://discord.gg/pG8jxEZrfu"]discord.gg/pG8jxEZrfu[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]Support Email: [/b][url="https://support@mbtactics.com"]contact@mbtactics.com[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll investigate promptly and provide one-on-one technical support.[/p][p][/p][p]Once again, I deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused by my mistake. We will strengthen our update testing and review processes to prevent similar issues in the future. Thank you for your understanding, support, and for joining us on the adventure of 16 Cyber-Personalities: Survivors![/p][p]Happy gaming and best wishes on your journey,
[/p][p]— The MBTactics Development Team[/p]

notes.title: V0.1.0: Demo Now Live!
notes.notes:
HELLO my dear players!

We are MBTactics — still learning the ropes of tactical combat!
We’re beyond excited to present to you our very first [b]Demo[/b]!

[h2]Demo Content[/h2]
This is our first public-facing demo, and it features the core gameplay loop we’ve been working hard on:

[h3]Questionnaire Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] Inspired by MBTI personality tests
[*] Fight battles while answering a series of game-related questions to grow stronger.
[*] It also serves as a tutorial to help you get familiar with the basic controls.
[/list]

At the end, you’ll receive your own unique gaming personality type!
Share it with your friends — and trick them into… ahem, invite them to take the test too :D

[h3]Roguelite Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] Step beyond your personality type and freely mix and match four companions (we call them Sprites).
[*] Each Sprite has two stages of evolution and four branching paths.
[*] Every personality type comes with unique abilities and eight enhanced skill upgrades.
[*] There are hundreds of traits to choose from to shape a character build that’s uniquely yours.
[/list]

This mode is significantly more challenging than Questionnaire Mode — failure is totally normal! Don’t give up and don’t be discouraged :)
The longer you survive, the more psychological energy (Libido) you’ll earn, tied to your current personality type.

You can use this Libido for meta-progression in the Mandala panel, unlocking permanent upgrades.

[h3]Meta-progression[/h3]
Our meta-progression system is inspired by Jungian cognitive functions.
By playing different personality types, you'll earn corresponding Libido points, which unlock upgrades themed around each personality function.

Some are simple — like faster leveling or trait rerolls — while others introduce entirely new systems such as skill inheritance, fusion, and personality masks.
There are even upgrades that offer insight into personality theory itself…

In this demo, you can experience the first ring of the Mandala panel.
The full version will unlock all five rings — with a ton more fun and powerful upgrades to explore!

[h3]Persona Masks[/h3]
The demo features nearly 20 unique Persona Masks, each offering a distinct playstyle.

Once you unlock the “Persona Mask” upgrade in the Mandala panel’s Harmony Axis, you’ll be able to choose a mask before each run to empower your character.

Masks often come with powerful effects — and meaningful drawbacks.
Experiment and see how different masks synergize with different personality types!

We’re sure you’ll discover wild combinations we never even imagined~

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]
In the full release, we plan to deliver the complete game experience! Here’s what we’ve got in mind:

[h3]Maps[/h3]
Demo: One map themed around "Greed."
Full Release: Three maps — Greed, Wrath, and Delusion.
Future: If the game doesn’t flop… maybe we’ll cover all six realms of existence!

[h3]Meta-progression[/h3]
Demo: One ring available.
Full Release: All five rings unlocked.
Future: No promises yet, but if we release DLC, we might add a second page to the board!

[h3]Persona Masks[/h3]
Demo: 14 masks.
Full Release: 49 masks!
Future: The system is expandable — we might add even more in free updates, or even support Steam Workshop so players can design their own!

[h3]Traits[/h3]
Demo: Over 200 traits already included!
Full Release: We may add more if we have the capacity, but no guarantees.
Future: We do promise ongoing free trait updates — many are already designed, we just need time to implement and illustrate them.

[h3]Localization[/h3]
Demo: Supports Simplified Chinese and English.
Full Release: Japanese, Korean and Traditional Chinese localizations in progress — hoping to launch them on time!
Future: If you'd like to help bring the game to more languages, feel free to reach out~

[h3]More Personality Type Content?[/h3]
Demo: 16 personality types, each with unique skills and 8 advanced skill upgrades.
Full Release: Each personality will gain an Awakening Skill and 8 Fusion Skills tied to other types!
Future: We dream of creating gender-swapped “alternate” versions of each personality type — with all-new skills. That would effectively double the cast to 32. If the game survives, we’ll do it!

[h3]Sprite Evolutions[/h3]
Demo: 8 Sprites, each with 2 evolutions and 4 branches. Art is complete, but animations are still WIP.
Full Release: Every Sprite’s evolutions will be fully animated for combat!
Future: We’d love to give every Sprite 4 more branches. Fingers crossed~

[h2]A Friendly Disclaimer[/h2]
This game is inspired by Jungian psychology and MBTI theory, but it’s ultimately a work of entertainment.

Please don’t treat any of the personality descriptions as “serious psychological analysis.”
Some stereotypes or simplifications were made for clarity and gameplay purposes — they are not meant to define anyone.

We’re all [b]unique[/b] individuals. Personality frameworks are just tools for [b]self-discovery[/b], not boxes to trap people in.

Don’t use personality types to label or judge others, okay?

[h2]In Closing[/h2]
We hope you enjoy playing!
If you like the demo, we humbly ask for a positive review! >_<

Got feedback? We’d love to hear it.
While we can’t guarantee we’ll meet everyone’s wishes, we’ll do our best to thoughtfully consider every suggestion.

We’ll continue adjusting the balance, difficulty, and values based on your feedback.
We won’t nerf a personality type unless absolutely necessary — our goal is for each type to feel strong and fun in its own unique way.

[h3]Contact Us[/h3]
Whether you're into the game itself, or interested in MBTI, psychology, or typology — come join our community!

Discord: https://discord.gg/3X44kH6W
